read.thesis: Corteva cut FY26 adjusted EBITDA to $1.1–1.125B (from $4.1–4.3B prior basis, different metric) as Brazil crop protection collapsed; Q3 Latin America organic sales fell 31% on 24% volume drop and channel inventory.

triggers.label: Brazil channel inventory elevated, volumes -24%
triggers.quote: Volumes decreased 24% due to elevated channel inventory and delayed purchasing given farmer liquidity constraints and high interest rates.

triggers.label: FY26 EBITDA guide cut to $1.1–1.125B
triggers.quote: Adjusted Pro Forma Operating EBITDA is now expected to be between $1.1 billion and $1.125 billion
triggers.highlight: now expected to be between $1.1 billion and $1.125 billion

triggers.label: Q3 price down 7%, Brazil and acetochlor
triggers.quote: Pricing declined 7%, driven by competitive pressure on molecules late in their lifecycle in Brazil and U.S. acetochlor.

guidance.metric: FY26 adjusted pro forma operating EBITDA
guidance.quote: Adjusted Pro Forma Operating EBITDA is now expected to be between $1.1 billion and $1.125 billion

guidance.metric: FY26 adjusted pro forma operating EPS
guidance.quote: Adjusted Pro Forma Operating EPS1 is expected to be between $0.76 and $0.80 per share.
The Company expects to record approximately $130 million to $140 million net pre-tax restructuring charges during 2026
